rule: For operating companies, retain CV <= 0.35. A higher CV passes the margin-variation check only if all observations in the existing last-ten-year window (at least seven) have finite positive operating margins, consecutive fiscal years, finite nonnegative net income in every year, no year-on-year margin decrease, and final margin strictly greater than first. Missing observations, gaps, operating losses, net losses, sign changes, declines and swings cannot qualify for the exception. Existing low-CV passes and all other thresholds are unchanged. The raw CV remains unchanged for valuation volatility and price discounts. Financial companies are unchanged. The existing provisional-LTM and two-quarter confirmation machinery applies unchanged.
parameters: No new numerical cutoffs. Seven, ten and 0.35 are existing parameters; strict positivity, nonnegative net income, consecutive years, monotonicity and overall improvement derive from the approved principle. No return tuning.
ship_gate: US train AND Western non-US train/test AND all markets train/test: candidate CAGR >= baseline - 0.0025 AND max drawdown >= baseline - 0.02. Enumerate every changed current verdict. US 2016-2026 contaminated, excluded from decision. Missing material validation = NOT.
measurement: research-1 b1d578b analyze.py plus corrected-portfolio-function.py; adjusted total returns, first local session close, quarterly liquidation/reentry, 10bp per side, cash gaps and missing allocation, zero cash yield. USD portfolios. Three-year gross security hit rate vs same-quarter universe median, equal-weight mean of quarterly hit rates. Winner=quarter top decile; loser=negative total return, plus below-median separately.
periods: Portfolio train signals 2005Q1–2015Q3, outcomes through 2015-12-31; 2015Q4 embargoed. Later signals 2016Q1–2026Q2. Train 3y cohort outcomes must end by 2015-12-31; later mature cohorts through 2026-09-30.
comparison: Paired same-input baseline and candidate replay; stored baseline shown separately and mismatches audited. Unreplayable rows stay stored baseline in both variants, and coverage explicitly reported. Existing stored baselines are not replaced silently. Recompute downstream valuation only through unchanged existing quality-pass dependency. No fair-value variant.
scope: US by country as research-1; Western non-US uses research-1 direct venue definition; all markets includes US and non-US, with separate all-non-US sensitivity. No acquisition unless cached observations insufficient; no EODHD calls.
